question: Using HPA cell-line analysis scores, compare every PROGENy signature with every CytoSig signature across cell lines measured by both. For each signature pair use finite z-scores, require at least thirty shared cell lines, and calculate Spearman correlation without filtering on the supplied significance label. Report the number of eligible pairs and the ten largest absolute correlations, with signed rho and matched-cell-line count; break ties by PROGENy name then CytoSig name. For the strongest pair fit an ordinary least-squares line predicting CytoSig z-score from PROGENy z-score on the same matched lines. Report slope, intercept and R-squared, then the twelve cell lines with the largest absolute residual, ties alphabetically. Give their scores, prediction, residual and primary disease from the cell-line metadata, without exporting patient metadata. Draw the correlation heatmap and a score scatter of the twelve largest-residual cell lines with the fitted line, plus residual bars; supply the correlation matrix and the twelve-cell-line table and avoid treating correlated inferred signatures as proof of pathway causality. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT analysis_type, name, cell_line,
         TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS z,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY analysis_type, name ORDER BY TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE)) AS rn
  FROM cell_line_analysis_data
  WHERE TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT analysis_type, name, cell_line, z,
         AVG(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY analysis_type, name, z) AS r
  FROM base
),
p AS (SELECT name, cell_line, r FROM ranked WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy'),
c AS (SELECT name, cell_line, r FROM ranked WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig'),
pairs AS (
  SELECT p.name AS progeny, c.name AS cytosig,
         COUNT(*) AS n_shared,
         ROUND(corr(p.r, c.r), 6) AS spearman
  FROM p JOIN c USING (cell_line)
  GROUP BY 1,2
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairs) AS n_eligible_pairs,
       progeny, cytosig, spearman, n_shared
FROM pairs
ORDER BY ABS(spearman) DESC, progeny ASC, cytosig ASC"}

{"query": "WITH p AS (SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS x FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='PROGENy' AND name='TGFb'),
c AS (SELECT cell_line, TRY_CAST(z_score AS DOUBLE) AS y FROM cell_line_analysis_data WHERE analysis_type='CytoSig' AND name='TGFB1'),
j AS (SELECT p.cell_line, p.x, c.y FROM p JOIN c USING (cell_line)),
fit AS (SELECT REGR_SLOPE(y,x) AS s, REGR_INTERCEPT(y,x) AS b FROM j),
res AS (
  SELECT j.cell_line, j.x, j.y,
         f.s * j.x + f.b AS yhat,
         j.y - (f.s * j.x + f.b) AS resid
  FROM j CROSS JOIN fit f
),
rk AS (
  SELECT cell_line, x, y, yhat, resid,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(resid) DESC, cell_line ASC) AS rn
  FROM res
)
SELECT rk.rn,
       rk.cell_line,
       COALESCE(m."Primary disease", 'not in metadata') AS primary_disease,
       ROUND(rk.x,4) AS progeny_TGFb_z,
       ROUND(rk.y,4) AS cytosig_TGFB1_z,
       ROUND(rk.yhat,4) AS predicted_TGFB1,
       ROUND(rk.resid,4) AS residual,
       ROUND(ABS(rk.resid),4) AS abs_residual
FROM rk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "Cell line", "Primary disease" FROM rna_cell_lines) m
  ON rk.cell_line = m."Cell line"
WHERE rk.rn <= 13
ORDER BY rk.rn"}
